subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw retain `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` as a public Plugin SDK capability with harness-owner reset coordination, or should this lifecycle behavior remain behind a narrower owner-specific seam?
rationale: The PR solves the Teams bug, but its solution adds a general plugin-facing session-mutation contract that can shape future external plugin behavior and cannot be selected safely from tests alone.

options.title: Accept the public lifecycle API
options.body: Keep the guarded SDK operation and document it as the canonical way for owner plugins to rotate a session after an external lifecycle boundary.

options.title: Narrow the seam first
options.body: Move the reset capability behind a more restricted owner/runtime interface, then adapt the Teams plugin without adding a broad public SDK operation.

recommendation.title: Accept the public lifecycle API
recommendation.body: Keep the guarded SDK operation and document it as the canonical way for owner plugins to rotate a session after an external lifecycle boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows direct involvement in narrowing the Teams lifecycle behavior, making this the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-plugin API decision.
